notes.title: Postponing the release date
notes.notes:
I welcome everyone, friends!

This year has turned out to be difficult for everyone, as well as for me. I work on the game practically alone and I also solve a bunch of family and life problems. I don't have enough time to release the game this year, as I wanted.

But development continues and never stands still! At the moment I am in the final stages of processing the game, "gluing" the mechanics of the game into a coherent whole.

[b]The game is expected to be released in February 2021.[/b]

Thanks to everyone, friends, who support me on Twitter, as well as to all those who are not indifferent who added the game to the wishlist ;)


See you soon!
Max.
